description: Reads ESRI Shapefile format and converts to spatial data with CRS support and geometry validation.

file_path.info: Select a .zip archive containing shapefile components (.shp, .shx, .dbf, .prj) or a .shp file.

file_id_variable.info: Reference an file variable for file ID (e.g., {shapefileId}). Takes precedence over file selection if both provided.

target_crs.info: Target coordinate reference system for the output data. EPSG:4326 is standard GPS coordinates (WGS84).

encoding.info: Character encoding for the .dbf file (e.g., utf-8, gbk, gb2312, latin1).

validate_geometry.info: Check if geometries are valid (no self-intersections, proper topology, etc.).

fix_invalid.info: Attempt to automatically fix invalid geometries using buffer(0) method.

spatial_data.info: Geographic features as Data objects with spatial metadata (_geometry_wkt, _geometry_type, _crs).

success.loaded: Successfully loaded {count} features with geometry types: {types} (CRS: {crs})

errors.missing_libraries: Shapefile processing requires 'geopandas' and 'fiona'. Install with: uv sync --group spatial
errors.empty_file: Shapefile is empty or contains no features
errors.validation_failed: Found {count} invalid geometries. Enable 'Fix Invalid Geometries' to attempt automatic repair.
errors.no_file_source: Please provide either a file selection or an file variable for file ID
errors.variable_not_resolved: Variable '{variable}' not found in runtime or global variables. Please check: (1) Variable is defined in Global Variables settings, or (2) Variable is passed in runtime variables when executing the flow.

warnings.no_crs: No CRS detected in Shapefile, defaulting to EPSG:4326 (WGS84)
warnings.unfixed_geometries: {count} geometries could not be automatically fixed
